title.en: Domi Dora and Zhi Zhi Stage Live Breakup Showdown with 20,000 Simultaneous Viewers
title.zh-TW: 多米多羅、芝芝開直播攤牌　「2萬人同時在線」看分手對質

summary.en: YouTuber Domi Dora and ex-girlfriend Zhi Zhi held a live stream confrontation over their breakup, drawing 20,000 simultaneous viewers. Both issued final statements addressing living expenses, family involvement, and reconciliation attempts. Domi Dora claimed he covered most costs and sought an amicable split, while Zhi Zhi shared a timeline of events.
summary.zh-TW: YouTuber多米多羅（Domi Dora）與前女友芝芝（Zhi Zhi）舉行直播分手對質，吸引2萬人同時在線。雙方發出最終聲明，針對生活費、家人介入與復合爭議回應。多米多羅稱自行負擔大部分開銷並盼好聚好散，芝芝則公開事件時間線。

body.en: Lede: YouTuber Domi Dora and Zhi Zhi conducted a public live stream to address their breakup, attracting 20,000 simultaneous online viewers according to ETtoday星光雲 reports. What happened: Domi Dora issued a final statement clarifying he bore most cohabitation expenses, denying repeated family interventions, and expressing a desire for an amicable separation. Zhi Zhi released a nighttime final statement with a detailed timeline of events. Additional coverage from 娛樂星聞 noted Domi Dora's sister accused Zhi Zhi of double standards and maintaining contact with an ex. Why it matters: The public dispute highlights how personal relationship conflicts among Taiwanese internet personalities can escalate into widespread online spectacles involving live audiences and multiple statements. Sources agree/disagree: Outlets including ETtoday星光雲 and 娛樂星聞 consistently report the live stream viewership figure and the issuance of final statements by both parties. Still uncertain: Exact details of expense breakdowns and family roles remain based on individual statements without independent verification.
body.zh-TW: Lede: YouTuber多米多羅（Domi Dora）與芝芝（Zhi Zhi）舉行公開直播對質分手事件，據ETtoday星光雲報導吸引2萬人同時在線。 What happened: 多米多羅發出最後聲明澄清自行負擔大部分同居生活費，否認家人多次介入，並表示盼好聚好散。芝芝深夜發布最終聲明，公開完整事件時間線。娛樂星聞等報導提及多米多羅大姊指控芝芝雙標並與前男友聯絡未斷。 Why it matters: 此公開爭議顯示台灣網路名人私人間感情紛爭如何演變為吸引大量觀眾的線上 spectacle。 Sources agree/disagree: ETtoday星光雲與娛樂星聞等媒體一致報導直播觀看人數及雙方發布最終聲明之事。 Still uncertain: 開銷細節與家人角色等仍依個人聲明，缺乏獨立查證。

title.en: Braden Peters Known as Clavicular Faces Rape Charges in Massachusetts
title.zh-TW: 布雷登·彼得斯（Braden Peters）以克拉維庫拉（Clavicular）之名在麻薩諸塞州面臨強姦指控

summary.en: Influencer Braden Peters, known online as Clavicular, is a 20-year-old Miami-based personality facing rape charges. Sources report two felony charges and one misdemeanor after allegations involving a 17-year-old victim. Peters denies the claims.
summary.zh-TW: 線上影響者布雷登·彼得斯（Braden Peters），網路暱稱克拉維庫拉（Clavicular），為20歲邁阿密居民，面臨強姦指控。消息指出兩項重罪與一項輕罪，指控涉及17歲受害者。彼得斯否認指控。

body.en: Lede: Braden Peters, the influencer known as Clavicular, has been charged with rape in Massachusetts according to multiple reports. What happened: Hollywood Life identifies Clavicular as Braden Peters, a 20-year-old Miami-based influencer. CBS News reports he faces two felony charges and one misdemeanor charge related to rape. NPR states a girl accuses him of non-consensual sex with a 17-year-old female victim after plying her with alcohol. Why it matters: The case involves a social media personality in the looksmaxxing community and has drawn coverage from entertainment and news outlets. Sources agree/disagree: All sources confirm the real name Braden Peters, the online name Clavicular, and that he denies the allegations. Still uncertain: Details beyond the charges and denial are limited to the provided reports.
body.zh-TW: 導言：根據多份報導，以克拉維庫拉（Clavicular）聞名的影響者布雷登·彼得斯（Braden Peters）在麻薩諸塞州遭強姦指控。 事件經過：好萊塢生活報導克拉維庫拉（Clavicular）本名布雷登·彼得斯（Braden Peters），為20歲邁阿密影響者。哥倫比亞廣播公司新聞指出他面臨兩項重罪與一項輕罪指控。國家公共廣播電台報導一名女孩指控他對17歲女性受害者施以酒精後發生非自願性行為。 事件重要性：此案涉及社群媒體影響者與外貌最大化社群，吸引娛樂與新聞媒體關注。 消息來源異同：所有來源均確認本名布雷登·彼得斯（Braden Peters）、網路名稱克拉維庫拉（Clavicular），並指出他否認指控。 仍未確定事項：除指控與否認外，細節僅限於所提供報導。

title.en: CNN, MS NOW and Politico Sue Trump; Paramount Settles Warner Bros. Discovery Merger Lawsuit
title.zh-TW: 美國有線電視新聞網（CNN）、MS NOW 與 Politico 控告川普；派拉蒙（Paramount）和解華納兄弟探索（Warner Bros. Discovery）併購訴訟

summary.en: CNN, MS NOW and Politico filed suit against President Trump after their White House access was suspended. Paramount reached a settlement in a lawsuit tied to its Warner Bros. Discovery merger. The White House launched a 24/7 YouTube channel called Trump TV following the ban on the three outlets.
summary.zh-TW: 美國有線電視新聞網（CNN）、MS NOW 與 Politico 在白宮通行證被停用後對川普總統提起訴訟。派拉蒙（Paramount）就其與華納兄弟探索（Warner Bros. Discovery）併購相關的訴訟達成和解。白宮在三家媒體遭禁後推出名為川普電視（Trump TV）的二十四小時 YouTube 頻道。

body.en: Lede: Three major news organizations sued President Trump after losing White House access, while Paramount settled a merger-related lawsuit. What happened: CNN, MS NOW (formerly MSNBC) and Politico sued to regain entry to the White House following suspension of their badges. The suit accuses the administration of violating the US constitution. Separately, Paramount made concessions to resolve litigation over its Warner Bros. Discovery merger. Days after barring the three outlets, the White House launched a 24/7 YouTube channel titled Trump TV. Why it matters: The lawsuit represents a significant press-administration conflict over access rights. The merger settlement concludes a major corporate legal dispute. Sources agree/disagree: All sources confirm the lawsuit by CNN, MS NOW and Politico and the White House response. The Paramount settlement appears only in the NPR World report. Still uncertain: Details on the exact timing of badge suspensions and the full terms of the Paramount settlement remain unspecified in the provided sources.
body.zh-TW: 導言：三家主要新聞機構在失去白宮通行權後對川普總統提起訴訟，同時派拉蒙（Paramount）就併購相關訴訟達成和解。 事件經過：美國有線電視新聞網（CNN）、MS NOW（前身為 MSNBC）與 Politico 在通行證被停用後提起訴訟，要求恢復進入白宮的權利。訴訟指控政府違反美國憲法。此外，派拉蒙（Paramount）作出讓步以解決與華納兄弟探索（Warner Bros. Discovery）併購相關的訴訟。在禁止三家媒體進入白宮數日後，白宮推出名為川普電視（Trump TV）的二十四小時 YouTube 頻道。 重要性：此訴訟代表新聞界與政府在通行權上的重大衝突。併購和解結束了一項大型企業法律爭議。 來源一致與分歧：所有來源均確認美國有線電視新聞網（CNN）、MS NOW 與 Politico 的訴訟及白宮回應。派拉蒙（Paramount）和解僅出現於 NPR World 報導。 仍未確定：通行證停用確切時間及派拉蒙（Paramount）和解完整條款在來源中未詳述。

imageAlt.en: Cover related to: Muse, Meta's extraordinarily privileged AI assistant, has a serious 0-day
imageAlt.zh-TW: 相關封面圖：Meta（Meta） 的 Muse AI 助理 在 App Store 病毒式成功後面臨零時差漏洞

title.en: Meta's Muse AI Assistant Faces Zero-Day Vulnerability After Viral App Store Success
title.zh-TW: Meta（Meta） 的 Muse AI 助理 在 App Store 病毒式成功後面臨零時差漏洞

summary.en: Meta's Muse app tops App Store charts and outpaces ChatGPT downloads, boosting AI strategy confidence per MarketWatch. Ars Technica reports a zero-day flaw allowing local apps full control, contradicting Zuckerberg's privacy claims, with Amazon blocking the app shortly after its recent launch.
summary.zh-TW: 根據 MarketWatch，Meta（Meta） 的 Muse 應用程式登上 App Store 排行榜，超越 ChatGPT 早期下載速度，提升 AI 策略信心。Ars Technica 報導零時差漏洞讓本地應用程式取得完整控制權，與祖克柏（Mark Zuckerberg） 隱私宣稱相悖，Amazon 已在推出數週後封鎖該應用。

body.en: Lede: Meta's Muse AI assistant has achieved rapid viral success on app stores while facing a reported serious zero-day security vulnerability. What happened: MarketWatch notes Muse topping App Store charts and beating ChatGPT’s early download pace, spurring renewed confidence in the company’s AI strategy. Ars Technica states Meta founder and CEO Mark Zuckerberg hyped the security of Muse, claiming it is built from the ground up for privacy and security. A zero-day vulnerability gives locally run apps and terminal commands complete control of the agent. Amazon on Sunday began blocking Muse from its site. Meta introduced Muse a few weeks ago. The assistant books appointments, fills out forms and handles customer tasks. Why it matters: The combination of strong user adoption and security concerns raises questions about the balance between rapid AI deployment and protection measures in Meta's products. Sources agree/disagree: MarketWatch focuses on positive download metrics and strategy confidence. Ars Technica highlights the vulnerability and blocking action. No direct conflicts on shared facts. Still uncertain: Details on the full scope of the vulnerability impact or Amazon's exact reasons remain limited to the provided reports.
body.zh-TW: 導言：Meta（Meta） 的 Muse AI 助理 在應用程式商店取得快速病毒式成功，同時面臨報導中的嚴重零時差安全漏洞。 事件經過：MarketWatch 指出 Muse 登上 App Store 排行榜，超越 ChatGPT 早期下載速度，提升該公司 AI 策略信心。Ars Technica 表示 Meta 創辦人兼執行長 馬克·祖克柏（Mark Zuckerberg） 大力宣傳 Muse 的安全性，聲稱其從頭建置以確保隱私與安全。一項零時差漏洞讓本地執行的應用程式與終端命令取得代理程式的完整控制權。Amazon 已在週日開始從其網站封鎖 Muse。Meta 數週前推出 Muse。該助理可預約、填寫表格並處理客戶任務。 重要性：強勁使用者採用與安全疑慮的結合，引發關於 Meta 產品快速 AI 部署與保護措施平衡的疑問。 來源同意或分歧：MarketWatch 聚焦正面下載數據與策略信心。Ars Technica 強調漏洞與封鎖行動。共享事實無直接衝突。 仍不確定：漏洞影響完整範圍或 Amazon 確切原因的細節，僅限於所提供報導。

imageAlt.zh-TW: 相關封面圖：唐納·川普（Donald Trump）披露逾1100筆7月交易 包含微軟（Microsoft）與亞馬遜（Amazon）出售

title.en: Donald Trump Discloses Over 1,100 July Trades Including Microsoft and Amazon Sales
title.zh-TW: 唐納·川普（Donald Trump）披露逾1100筆7月交易 包含微軟（Microsoft）與亞馬遜（Amazon）出售

summary.en: Donald Trump filed disclosures showing more than 1,100 stock trades in July, with sales of Microsoft and Amazon stock each reaching up to $25 million on July 20. The trades occurred as major tech stocks rose sharply that day. Reports from CNBC and The Guardian detail purchases and sales totaling between $79 million and $270 million.
summary.zh-TW: 唐納·川普（Donald Trump）提交文件顯示7月進行逾1100筆股票交易，7月20日出售微軟（Microsoft）與亞馬遜（Amazon）股票各達2500萬美元。交易發生在科技股大漲當日。CNBC與衛報報導指出買賣總額介於7900萬至2.7億美元。

body.en: Lede: Donald Trump reported more than 1,100 stock trades for July, including large sales of Microsoft and Amazon shares. What happened: According to filings analyzed by CNBC and The Guardian, Trump executed over 440 purchases and 700 sales in July. The two largest transactions were sales of Amazon and Microsoft stock, each between $5 million and $25 million, completed on July 20. Additional sales included Oracle, Costco, and Nvidia shares. Why it matters: The disclosures highlight trading activity by an elected official amid public scrutiny over stock trading by politicians. The sales coincided with a single-day gain of $291 billion in market value for Mag 7 stocks. Sources agree/disagree: Both outlets confirm the July 20 sales of Microsoft and Amazon up to $25 million each and the overall scale of activity exceeding 1,000 trades. Minor differences appear in reported totals, with one citing more than 1,100 trades and the other specifying 440 purchases plus 700 sales worth $79 million to $270 million. Still uncertain: Exact individual trade sizes beyond the reported ranges and the full list of all holdings remain subject to further review of the disclosures.
body.zh-TW: 導言：唐納·川普（Donald Trump）申報7月超過1100筆股票交易，包含微軟（Microsoft）與亞馬遜（Amazon）的大額出售。 事件經過：根據CNBC與衛報分析的文件，川普7月執行逾440筆買入與700筆賣出。最大兩筆交易為7月20日出售微軟（Microsoft）與亞馬遜（Amazon）股票，各介於500萬至2500萬美元。另有甲骨文（Oracle）、好市多（Costco）與輝達（Nvidia）股票出售。 重要性：這些揭露凸顯民選官員的交易活動，適逢公眾對政客股票交易的關注。出售發生在七大科技股單日市值增加2910億美元之際。 來源異同：兩家媒體均確認7月20日微軟（Microsoft）與亞馬遜（Amazon）各出售達2500萬美元，以及交易規模超過1000筆。細節略有差異，一方稱逾1100筆交易，另一方則列出440筆買入加700筆賣出，總值7900萬至2.7億美元。 仍未確定：超出已報範圍的個別交易確切規模，以及全部持股完整清單，仍待進一步審查文件。

disagreements.en: Slight variations in trade counts (more than 1,100 vs. 440 purchases plus 700 sales) and total value ranges ($79m-$270m).
disagreements.zh-TW: 交易筆數略有差異（逾1100筆 vs 440筆買入加700筆賣出）以及總值範圍（7900萬至2.7億美元）。

title.en: Wu Zongxian, Jolin Tsai, Yao Zhengjing and Other Taiwanese Celebrities Face Breakup and Divorce Reports
title.zh-TW: 吳宗憲（Wu Zongxian）、蔡依林（Jolin Tsai）、姚正菁（Yao Zhengjing）等台灣藝人爆分手離婚消息

summary.en: Multiple Taiwanese entertainment reports detail celebrity relationship endings. Jolin Tsai ends six-year romance with Jinrong while Wu Zongxian reflects on artist marriages. Yao Zhengjing explains past split from Aaron Kwok and faces cold reception on comeback. Other stories cover divorces involving Chen Yingjie, Zhang Weiwei and Xiaodao.
summary.zh-TW: 多篇台灣娛樂報導揭露藝人感情結束消息。蔡依林結束與錦榮六年戀情，吳宗憲感慨藝人婚姻難幸福。姚正菁剖白與郭富城分手原因，復出遭前輩白眼。另有陳盈潔、張葳葳、小刀等離婚相關報導。

body.en: Lede: Taiwanese entertainment outlets report several high-profile relationship endings and reflections from celebrities including Wu Zongxian, Jolin Tsai and Yao Zhengjing. What happened: 三立新聞 reports Jolin Tsai ended a six-year relationship with Jinrong, prompting Wu Zongxian to comment that artist marriages struggle to find happiness. 噓！星聞 covers Wu Zongxian giving all property to his ex-wife in a divorce twelve years ago and experts criticizing the decision. Additional 噓！星聞 items note Chen Yingjie’s ex-husband visiting her deathbed after twenty years apart, Wu Zongxian discussing gradual distance in his divorce from Zhang Weiwei, and Xiaodao allegedly divorcing two years ago while hiding it for a 5566 comeback. 明報 Our Lifestyle details Yao Zhengjing explaining her past breakup with Aaron Kwok and receiving cold stares from senior artists upon her return. Why it matters: These stories highlight ongoing public interest in the personal lives of Taiwanese entertainers and the challenges they face in relationships and comebacks. Sources agree/disagree: All sources focus on breakup and divorce topics without conflicting details on names or timelines. Still uncertain: Specific reasons behind some splits remain limited to individual statements from the celebrities involved.
body.zh-TW: 導言：台灣娛樂媒體報導多起藝人感情結束與相關反思，包括吳宗憲、蔡依林與姚正菁等。 事件經過：三立新聞報導蔡依林結束與錦榮六年戀情，吳宗憲感慨藝人婚姻難幸福。噓！星聞提及吳宗憲十二年前離婚將財產全給前妻，專家批評此舉。另有噓！星聞報導陳盈潔離世前離婚二十年前夫趕赴病榻道別、吳宗憲談與張葳葳漸行漸遠原因，以及小刀遭爆兩年前已離婚卻為5566復出隱瞞婚變。明報 Our Lifestyle 詳述姚正菁剖白當年與郭富城分手原因，復出遭前輩藝人白眼。 重要性：這些報導反映台灣娛樂圈藝人私生活持續受關注，以及他們在感情與復出上面臨的挑戰。 來源一致性：所有來源聚焦分手離婚主題，姓名與時間點無衝突。 仍未確定：部分分手具體原因僅限涉事藝人個人說明。

title.en: Donald Trump Threatens to Annihilate Iran at United Nations Assembly
title.zh-TW: 唐納·川普（Donald Trump）在聯合國大會威脅消滅伊朗

summary.en: US President Donald Trump warned he may annihilate Iran if no peace deal is reached during his UN speech. Other leaders highlighted deep global divisions at the assembly. Trump also met UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham on the sidelines, praising their relations despite tensions over Iran and AI.
summary.zh-TW: 美國總統唐納·川普（Donald Trump）在聯合國演說中警告，若無法達成和平協議，可能消滅伊朗。其他領袖在會上強調全球嚴重分歧。川普並在場邊會晤英國首相安迪·伯納姆（Andy Burnham），讚揚雙邊關係。

body.en: Lede: US President Donald Trump stated he must decide whether to make a deal or annihilate Iran during his address at the UN General Assembly. What happened: Trump pondered extreme action against Iran in his speech while officials from both countries met on the sidelines. World leaders at the gathering typically focus on global harmony but instead warned of deep divisions. Why it matters: The remarks underscore escalating tensions between the US and Iran amid broader international disagreements. Sources agree/disagree: BBC World, NYT World and The Guardian UK News all report Trump's threat to annihilate Iran and note the unusual tone at the assembly. Still uncertain: Details on any specific outcomes from the US-Iran sidelines meetings remain limited in the provided reports.
body.zh-TW: 導言：美國總統唐納·川普（Donald Trump）在聯合國大會演說中表示，他必須決定是否達成協議或消滅伊朗。 事件經過：川普在演說中思考對伊朗採取極端行動，同時兩國官員在場邊會晤。與會領袖通常強調全球和諧，此次卻警告存在嚴重分歧。 重要性：此言論凸顯美伊緊張局勢升溫，以及國際間更廣泛的分歧。 來源一致或分歧：BBC World、NYT World 與 The Guardian UK News 均報導川普威脅消滅伊朗，並指出大會氛圍與往常不同。 仍未確定：美伊場邊會談的具體結果在提供的報導中仍有限。

title.en: Yang Mingwei and Fang Zhiyou Announce End of 11-Year Marriage
title.zh-TW: 楊銘威（Yang Mingwei）、方志友（Fang Zhiyou）宣布結束11年婚姻

summary.en: Taiwanese celebrities Yang Mingwei and Fang Zhiyou have announced their divorce after 11 years of marriage, stating they will remain family. Past comments from Jia Jingwen resurfaced describing Yang's behavior at home, while Fang noted she considered ending the marriage multiple times.
summary.zh-TW: 台灣藝人楊銘威（Yang Mingwei）與方志友（Fang Zhiyou）宣布結束11年婚姻，強調永遠是家人。賈靜雯（Jia Jingwen）昔日言論被翻出，提及楊在家像大少爺，方志友也曾表示想放棄婚姻不只一次。

body.en:
Lede: Yang Mingwei has made his first public appearance following reports of his divorce from Fang Zhiyou after 11 years of marriage.
What happened: Multiple outlets reported that Yang Mingwei and Fang Zhiyou announced the end of their 11-year marriage, with statements emphasizing they remain family. Older remarks from Jia Jingwen were recirculated, noting Yang often mentioned divorce after drinking and behaved like a young master at home. Fang Zhiyou previously acknowledged considering giving up on the marriage more than once.
Why it matters: The split joins other recent celebrity divorces in the region, drawing public attention to the couple's past statements.
Sources agree/disagree: Outlets consistently report the divorce announcement and reference the same past comments from Jia Jingwen and Fang Zhiyou.
Still uncertain: Details on the exact timing of the public appearance and any new statements from Yang Mingwei remain limited to the reported exposure.

來源一致／分歧：各報導一致提及離婚宣布及賈靜雯、方志友的舊有發言。
仍未確定：楊銘威最新現身細節與新聲明內容僅限於曝光報導。

title.en: Sri Lanka Court Convicts 15 in Easter 2019 Bomb Attacks
title.zh-TW: 斯里蘭卡（Sri Lanka）法院判定15人犯下2019年復活節爆炸案

summary.en: A Sri Lankan court convicted 15 men for coordinating the 2019 Easter Sunday bombings that struck three churches and three luxury hotels. The attacks killed hundreds and were among the deadliest in the country's history.
summary.zh-TW: 斯里蘭卡（Sri Lanka）法院判定15人參與策劃2019年復活節週日爆炸攻擊，目標包括三座教堂與三家豪華飯店，造成數百人死亡，是該國史上最嚴重攻擊之一。

body.en: Lede: Sri Lanka court convicts 15 men over the 2019 Easter bombings. What happened: A court found the 15 men guilty of coordinating suicide bombings on Easter Sunday 2019 that targeted three churches and three luxury hotels. The attacks killed 270 people according to BBC World, more than 300 according to NYT World, and included 42 foreigners per NPR World. The bombings were Islamic State group-inspired. Why it matters: The attacks rank among the deadliest in Sri Lanka's history. Sources agree/disagree: All three sources agree on the conviction of 15 men for the bombings. Still uncertain: Exact death toll varies across reports.
body.zh-TW: 導言：斯里蘭卡（Sri Lanka）法院判定15人犯下2019年復活節爆炸案。 事件經過：法院認定這15人策劃2019年復活節週日自殺炸彈攻擊，目標為三座教堂與三家豪華飯店。根據BBC World報導死亡人數為270人，NYT World則稱超過300人，NPR World指出其中包含42名外國人。這些攻擊受到伊斯蘭國（Islamic State）啟發。 事件重要性：這些攻擊是斯里蘭卡（Sri Lanka）史上最嚴重之一。 來源一致與分歧：三家來源均同意15人被判有罪。 仍未確定事項：死亡人數在各報導中有所差異。

disagreements.en: Sources differ on fatalities: BBC World reports 270 killed, NYT World states more than 300, NPR World notes 42 foreigners killed.

title.en: Outkast Sues Ovrkast for Trademark Infringement Over Nearly Identical Name
title.zh-TW: Outkast（Outkast） 控告 Ovrkast（Ovrkast） 商標侵權 指控名稱近乎相同

summary.en: Outkast has filed a trademark infringement lawsuit against rapper Ovrkast in Atlanta federal court, alleging the California artist Silas Wilson deliberately adopted a nearly identical name and reneged on a prior settlement agreement to change it.
summary.zh-TW: Outkast（Outkast） 在亞特蘭大聯邦法院對說唱歌手 Ovrkast（Ovrkast） 提起商標侵權訴訟，指控加州藝人 Silas Wilson（Silas Wilson） 故意採用近乎相同的名稱，並違背先前和解協議更改名字。

body.en: Lede: Outkast has sued rapper and producer Ovrkast for trademark infringement over his nearly identical name. What happened: In a lawsuit filed last week in Atlanta federal court, attorneys for the hip-hop duo André 3000 and Big Boi accused the California artist Silas Wilson of knowingly, willfully, intentionally, and maliciously trying to link himself to Outkast. The suit claims Ovrkast reneged on a secret settlement to change his name. Rolling Stone reports the Atlanta hip-hop duo says Ovrkast agreed to adopt a new name but later backed out of the deal. Why it matters: The case centers on protection of the Outkast brand, described in one report as famous and extremely valuable. Sources agree/disagree: Both Billboard and Rolling Stone confirm the filing of the trademark lawsuit and the claim that Ovrkast backed out of an agreement to change his name. Still uncertain: Details of the secret settlement remain limited to the court filing description.
body.zh-TW: 導言：Outkast（Outkast） 已對說唱歌手兼製作人 Ovrkast（Ovrkast） 提起商標侵權訴訟，指控其名稱近乎相同。 事件經過：上週在亞特蘭大聯邦法院提起的訴訟中，嘻哈二人組 André 3000（André 3000） 與 Big Boi（Big Boi） 的律師指控加州藝人 Silas Wilson（Silas Wilson） 明知、故意、蓄意且惡意地試圖與 Outkast（Outkast） 連結。訴訟聲稱 Ovrkast（Ovrkast） 違背秘密和解協議更改名稱。Rolling Stone 報導指出，亞特蘭大嘻哈二人組表示 Ovrkast（Ovrkast） 同意採用新名稱但後來退出協議。 事件重要性：案件核心在於保護 Outkast（Outkast） 品牌，一篇報導形容其為著名且極具價值。 來源一致與分歧：Billboard 與 Rolling Stone 均確認商標訴訟已提起，並提及 Ovrkast（Ovrkast） 退出更改名稱協議。 仍未確定事項：秘密和解的細節僅限於法院文件描述。
